newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Lung unit to set HK$4.8 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hang Lung unit to set HK$4.8 bln loan.

text.p: Hang Lung Treasury Ltd is seeking arrangers for its HK$4.8 billion revolving credit facility, bankers said.

The facility will be guaranteed by Hang Lung Development Co Ltd. It has a maturity of five years and pays a margin of 50 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. Fees are 10 basis points for underwriting and 40 basis points for arrangement, bankers said.
An arranger group is being formed.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for refinancing previous debts.
